## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: On fixture plans the linter reports a missing Spec scenarios field and an...

The system SHALL ensure that on fixture plans the linter reports a missing Spec scenarios field and an unresolvable scenario reference, and it passes on the template-shaped fixture.

#### Scenario: On fixture plans the linter reports a missing Spec scenarios field and an...

WHEN `add-deterministic-plan-artifact-linter` is implemented
THEN On fixture plans the linter reports a missing Spec scenarios field and an unresolvable scenario reference, and it passes on the template-shaped fixture.

### Requirement: CI blocks a newly created change that fails the linter and only warns for...

The system SHALL ensure that cI blocks a newly created change that fails the linter and only warns for changes that existed before the linter landed.

#### Scenario: CI blocks a newly created change that fails the linter and only warns for...

WHEN `add-deterministic-plan-artifact-linter` is implemented
THEN CI blocks a newly created change that fails the linter and only warns for changes that existed before the linter landed.

### Requirement: plan-feature and iterate-on-plan invoke the linter and surface its findings;...

The system SHALL ensure that plan-feature and iterate-on-plan invoke the linter and surface its findings; their SKILL.md edits are line-neutral or go into references/, and Gate 1/Gate 2 are unchanged.

#### Scenario: plan-feature and iterate-on-plan invoke the linter and surface its findings;...

WHEN `add-deterministic-plan-artifact-linter` is implemented
THEN plan-feature and iterate-on-plan invoke the linter and surface its findings; their SKILL.md edits are line-neutral or go into references/, and Gate 1/Gate 2 are unchanged.

### Requirement: The linter has a rules.yaml row with a recorded failing commit that...

The system SHALL ensure that the linter has a rules.yaml row with a recorded failing commit that prove_enforcer verifies, and its tests use change_dir() and pin no openspec/changes/<change-id>/ literals.

#### Scenario: The linter has a rules.yaml row with a recorded failing commit that...

WHEN `add-deterministic-plan-artifact-linter` is implemented
THEN The linter has a rules.yaml row with a recorded failing commit that prove_enforcer verifies, and its tests use change_dir() and pin no openspec/changes/<change-id>/ literals.
